name: Paths to *
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) CONTAINS '*' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to the * resource

name: Paths to IAM
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) = 'iam' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to the IAM resource

name: Paths to Principal
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND (z:AWSUser OR z:AWSRole OR z:AWSGroup OR z:AWSPrincipal) AND n<>z AND z.objectid = 'ARN:AWS:IAM::CHANGEME:ROLE/CHANGE' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to a principal

name: Paths from Principal
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(res:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND n.objectid = 'ARN:AWS:IAM::CHANGEME:USER/CHANGE' OPTIONAL MATCH rp = (res:AWSResource)-[*..]->(r) RETURN p, rp LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths from a principal

name: All Administrators
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSPolicy)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND (toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'administratoraccess' OR toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'poweruseraccess') RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all administrators

name: Roles Attached to Services
query: MATCH p = (:AWSResource)-[:awsCloudFormationStackRole|:awsCodeBuildProjectRole|:awsCodePipelineRole|:awsEc2InstanceRole|:awsEcsTaskRole|:awsEcsTaskExecutionRole|:awsEksClusterRole|:awsEksNodeRole|:awsLambdaInstanceRole|:awsRdsMonitoringRole|:awsRdsInstanceRole|:awsRdsClusterRole|:awsStateMachineRole]->()-[]->() RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all roles attached to a service

name: Paths to Inline Policies
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSPolicy)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND z.objectid CONTAINS ':INLINE/' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to inline policies

name: All Foreign Principals
query: MATCH p = (r:AWSPrincipal)-[:awsAssumeRoleAllowed]->(z)-[*..]->(res:AWSResource) WHERE NOT toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'aws' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all foreign principals

name: Paths to SecretsManager
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) = 'secretsmanager' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to SecretsManager

name: Paths to Resource with Edge Restriction
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND toLower(z.name) = 'lambda' WITH p WHERE any(r IN relationships(p) WHERE type(r) = 'lambdaAllAccess') RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to a resource with specific edges

name: Policies with Modify Permissions
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSPolicy)-[r]->(z:AWSResource) WHERE toLower(type(r)) CONTAINS 'create' OR toLower(type(r)) CONTAINS 'put' OR toLower(type(r)) CONTAINS 'update' OR toLower(type(r)) CONTAINS 'add' OPTIONAL MATCH rp = allShortestPaths((v)-[*..]->(n:AWSPolicy)) WHERE (v:AWSUser OR v:AWSRole OR v:AWSGroup OR v:AWSPrincipal) RETURN p,rp LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths with edges that allow you to modify resources

name: Resource Relationships Excluding AWS
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) and NOT toLower(n.name) CONTAINS 'aws' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths for resources

name: All Users
query: MATCH p = (r:AWSUser)-[*..]->(z:AWSPolicy) RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all users

name: All Policies Attached to Role
query: MATCH p = (r:AWSRole)-[*..]->(z:AWSPolicy) WHERE r.objectid='ARN:AWS:IAM::CHANGEME:ROLE/CHANGE' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all users

name: Access to S3 Bucket
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND (z:AWSResource) AND z.objectid = 'ARN:AWS:S3:::CHANGE' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to an S3 bucket

name: Identities Tied to Cognito
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSResource)-[:awsCognitoAuthenticatedRole|:awsCognitoUnauthenticatedRole]->(r)-[]->(:AWSPolicy) RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all identities tied to Cognito pools

name: All AgentCore Roles
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSResource)-[:awsAgentCoreRuntimeRole|:awsAgentCoreGatewayRole|:awsAgentCoreCodeInterpreterRole|:awsAgentCoreBrowserRole]->(r:AWSRole) WHERE toLower(n.name) = 'bedrock-agentcore' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all identities tied to AgentCore

name: Paths to AgentCore Roles
query: MATCH (h:AWSResource)-[:awsAgentCoreRuntimeRole|:awsAgentCoreGatewayRole|:awsAgentCoreCodeInterpreterRole|:awsAgentCoreBrowserRole]->(t:AWSRole) WHERE toLower(h.name) = 'bedrock-agentcore' MATCH p = allShortestPaths((s)-[*1..]->(t)) WHERE (s:AWSUser OR s:AWSRole OR s:AWSGroup OR s:AWSPrincipal) AND s <> t RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to AgentCore

name: All SageMaker Roles
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSResource)-[:awsSageMakerNotebookRole|:awsSageMakerDomainRole|:awsSageMakerUserProfileRole|:awsSageMakerModelRole|:awsSageMakerPipelineRole]->(r:AWSRole) WHERE toLower(n.name) = 'sagemaker' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all SageMaker roles

name: SageMaker Notebooks with Administrative Roles
query: MATCH p = (n:AWSResource)-[:awsSageMakerNotebookRole]->(r:AWSRole)-[:awsAttachedPolicy]->(z:AWSPolicy) WHERE toLower(n.name) = 'sagemaker' AND (toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'administratoraccess' OR toLower(z.name) CONTAINS 'poweruseraccess') RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify notebooks with administrative roles

name: Access to IaC Buckets
query: MATCH p = allShortestPaths((n)-[*..]->(z:AWSResource)) WHERE (n:AWSUser OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSGroup OR n:AWSPrincipal) AND z.iacTool IS NOT NULL RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all paths to IaC buckets

name: Wildcard Trust Conditions
query: MATCH p = (n)-[q:awsAssumeRoleAllowed]->(z:AWSRole) WHERE (n:AWSPrincipal OR n:AWSRole OR n:AWSUser) AND q.condition CONTAINS '*' RETURN p LIMIT 1000
description: Identify all trust relationships with a wildcard in their condition, including in-account role to role
